input.question: Why are mugshots public record and available to the press?
input.ground_truth: > Are all DUI arrests public record? All arrests period are public record. This is very important because if they were secret people could just disappear without the public being able to know what happened to them. Police action therefore must be transparent so that abuse can be stopped.

Question: Why are mugshots public record and available to the press?

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you are playing a game and someone takes a picture of you when you break a rule. That picture is called a "mugshot." Now, when someone breaks a big rule and the police have to take them to a special place (called jail), they take a mugshot to remember what they look like.

These pictures are put in a big book that everyone can look at, kind of like a library book. The reason is to help people know who has been caught breaking big rules, so if they see that person again, they can tell someone in charge. Also, newspapers and TV people (the press) can look at these pictures to tell everyone about what happened.

So, mugshots are public records so everyone can see who was caught breaking the rules and help keep everyone safe!
